mapIdentity.scope: Used native OpenStreetMap ways 1119202324 and 306337103 at the south parade frontage, the National Register inventory and the original USGS Rio Hondo bare-earth survey.

note: AllenS’s exact Qualla originals show the Adjutant’s Office's arcaded stone base, dark wood shingles, two-story porch and half-round dormer window, and the Second Guard House’s long single-story pale frontage and shallow entrance pediment.
